name: CODA
source:
You're the only human left in a world full of anthropomorphic animal people. You go to college and try to date one of them before you die of super cancer. Wholesome as hecc sometimes.

[From [url=https://codanon.itch.io/coda-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一个由兽人构成的世界里最后一个人类。你去上大学，想在死于超级癌症之前和其中一人约会。有时故事还挺暖心的。

[来源：[url=https://codanon.itch.io/coda-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
